assertion: An image appeared on the screen during the 14:00 paid matinee's title reel on 14 August 2027.
draft_context:
The cinema report includes the paid matinee.

An image appeared on the screen during the 14:00 paid matinee's title reel on 14 August 2027.

sources.text:
Cinema booth ledger, 14 August 2027

09:00, focusing run: The screen remained black throughout the title reel.

14:00, paid matinee: Doors opened and admissions were checked. The title reel was on the running order. The image-observation field is blank; there is no booth or house observation of the projected image for this show in the ledger.

20:00, closing show: The house observer watched the screen throughout the title reel. It remained dark throughout that reel.

The page headings for the 09:00 focusing run and the 20:00 closing show both read 'Screening'.

Amendment to the cinema booth ledger, 16 August 2027

I wrote the house-observation entries for 14 August. I transposed a line when entering the 09:00 focusing run. The title-reel image was visible on the screen during that run. I checked my photograph of the screen, which includes the 09:00 focusing slate. I retract the sentence saying that the screen remained black during the 09:00 title reel.

The 20:00 closing-show entry is unchanged: the screen remained dark throughout its title reel. I have no image observation to add for the 14:00 matinee.

Signed, Esme, house observer
